migrationRules: shipments + savedShipments must map to 128 canonical shipments
processStatus takes precedence over stale historical completion helpers
pickup/POD evidence keeps shipment locked even if status fields conflict
POD documents must have a dedicated cutover gate
ABD request documents must relink to their shipment reference
remote URLs are classified but not exposed in the safe document register
legacy passwords are never copied into normalized Professional users
customer locations are deduplicated per customer and no unresolved shipment location is guessed
audit detail text is preserved while structured secret keys are redacted in normalized audit details
generated document metadata is kept separately and never counted as a successfully migrated source file
